intro_line: Monterrey: steel, mountains, and the best carne asada in Mexico.
intro: Monterrey rewards visitors with dramatic mountain views, a lively old town, and world-class food. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Metrorrey subway is clean and cheap: about M$8.70 per ride; a rechargeable card costs about M$20.
City buses cost about M$15; pay with a 'Me Muevo' card or the Urbani app, cash is being phased out.
Ecovia BRT runs fast articulated buses on Av. Ruiz Cortines; transfers to Metrorrey are free.
Uber and DiDi both work well in the city.
Taxis are green-and-white or yellow-and-white; insist the driver uses the meter.
Driving is possible but traffic and parking are tricky; downtown hotels often offer free parking.

airports.name: General Mariano Escobedo International Airport
airports.note: Main airport for all commercial flights, about 24 km east of the centre in Apodaca.

options.note: Pick-up zones are marked outside the terminals.
Use authorized airport taxis; agree the fare first.
Book ahead; parking downtown can be hard.
